newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in quiet trade.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0764 per dollar in listless trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1640 local/1940 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $35 million surplus. On Wednesday, forex contracts posted a $596 million surplus.

Despite the large net dollar inflow, the real just rose 0.01 percent because some players are holding dollars to sell them on Monday, the last trading day of the month, in arbitraging operations with the forex futures market, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0810 per greenback, down 0.01 percent.
In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
